paragraphs: We love serving the Hampstead community with compassionate, comfortable dental care.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Our Hampstead office is located just off US-17, convenient to Surf City, Topsail Island, and Scotts Hill. Situated near Hampstead Town Center, our office makes it easy to fit a dental visit into your daily routine.

Riccobene Hampstead offers coastal families modern, calming dental care close to home. Whether you’re headed to the beach or commuting into Wilmington, our team is here to keep your smile bright and healthy.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Hampstead office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.

We strive to provide same day or next day care for those with dental emergencies, either at our Hampstead location or another convenient Riccobene location to prioritize solving urgent issues. Whether you have a broken or cracked tooth, a damaged crown, or undiagnosed severe tooth pain, we can help diagnose and treat urgent oral problems at our Hampstead location. Give us a call today to schedule an emergency appointment.
Yes - we can treat the whole family. Come on in today for your family and pediatric dentistry needs.

Yes - professional teeth whitening is one of our most popular cosmetic dental services, and we also offer services like veneers, Invisalign® treatment, and other procedures that can help improve the look and feel of your smile. Book an initial appointment with us today and we’ll work with you to understand your dental priorities, evaluate your dental health and make a plan to get your smile bright and white!
Yes - we offer expert care diagnosing and managing your dental implant procedure. Some implants can be performed in-office, while other procedures may be performed at an outpatient surgery facility.

Call us at (910) 270-3602 or book an appointment online and we’ll get you on the schedule for your first appointment, where we’ll inventory your oral health and make a plan for getting your dental hygiene on track!

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Hampstead office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What emergency dental services are available in Hampstead, NC?

We strive to provide same day or next day care for those with dental emergencies, either at our Hampstead location or another convenient Riccobene location to prioritize solving urgent issues. Whether you have a broken or cracked tooth, a damaged crown, or undiagnosed severe tooth pain, we can help diagnose and treat urgent oral problems at our Hampstead location. Give us a call today to schedule an emergency appointment.

Do you offer family and pediatric dentistry in Hampstead?

Yes - we can treat the whole family. Come on in today for your family and pediatric dentistry needs.

Can I get cosmetic dental services like teeth whitening or veneers in Hampstead?

Yes - professional teeth whitening is one of our most popular cosmetic dental services, and we also offer services like veneers, Invisalign® treatment, and other procedures that can help improve the look and feel of your smile. Book an initial appointment with us today and we’ll work with you to understand your dental priorities, evaluate your dental health and make a plan to get your smile bright and white!

Does the Hampstead office provide dental implants?

Yes - we offer expert care diagnosing and managing your dental implant procedure. Some implants can be performed in-office, while other procedures may be performed at an outpatient surgery facility.

How can I schedule an appointment with a Hampstead dentist?

Call us at (910) 270-3602 or book an appointment online and we’ll get you on the schedule for your first appointment, where we’ll inventory your oral health and make a plan for getting your dental hygiene on track!

What payment options and insurance plans does the Hampstead office accept?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
